explanation: erdosproblems.com/649: Alan Tong proved that for any prime p there are infinitely many primes q for which no n has P(n) = p and P(n+1) = q (choose q ≡ −1 mod 4m, m the product of primes ≤ p, and use quadratic reciprocity). The Lean statement: for prime p, {q prime | ¬∃ n, P(n) = p ∧ P(n+1) = q} is infinite. Faithful.
